steps.text: Rani went to the village market with 50 rupees. She wants to buy mangoes that cost 8 rupees each. Let us help her figure out how many mangoes she can buy!
How many mangoes can Rani buy with 50 rupees, if each mango costs 8 rupees?
Wonderful! 50 divided by 8 is 6, with 2 rupees left over as change. Rani buys 6 mangoes and has 2 rupees left. You are a great mathematician!
Good try! Let us think again. 8 times 6 equals 48, which is less than 50. 8 times 7 equals 56, which is more than 50. So Rani can only buy 6 mangoes. She gets 2 rupees back as change!
Excellent work! You finished the Market Day story. Division helps us share things fairly!
